sourceName: National Health and Aging Trends Study
protocolPurpose: Define the minimum missingness and endpoint-route gate required before any NHATS R13/R14 functional-survival, effective-time, route-count, missingness-rate, calibration or public Web output can interpret records as endpoint states rather than unresolved data-collection states.

currentDecision.reason: The route classes and dominance rules are registered, but exact R13/R14 status, proxy, facility, death-boundary, missing-code, design and disclosure fields are not confirmed. Only synthetic validator tests are allowed.

requiredRouteClasses.meaning: The sample person is alive at follow-up and represented by a direct self interview route.
requiredRouteClasses.minimumEvidence: Confirmed follow-up status and self-interview value labels from Colectica, codebook or official crosswalk.

requiredRouteClasses.meaning: The sample person is alive at follow-up and represented by a proxy interview or proxy measurement route.
requiredRouteClasses.minimumEvidence: Confirmed proxy status, substitution rule and endpoint aggregation rule.

requiredRouteClasses.meaning: The sample person is alive at follow-up and a facility, nursing-home, residential care or similar route changes endpoint interpretation.
requiredRouteClasses.minimumEvidence: Confirmed facility/residential route fields and public-use tier boundary.

requiredRouteClasses.meaning: The sample person is known alive but lacks a usable follow-up interview for endpoint component construction.
requiredRouteClasses.minimumEvidence: Confirmed known-alive noninterview category distinct from refusal, inapplicable, missing, proxy route and death boundary.

requiredRouteClasses.meaning: The follow-up route reaches a death, decedent or mortality boundary allowed by public-use fields.
requiredRouteClasses.minimumEvidence: Confirmed death/decedent indicator, value labels, file tier and no individual death-date output rule.

requiredRouteClasses.meaning: Follow-up status is unresolved because of refusal, don't know, nonresponse, skip logic, inapplicable value or missing data.
requiredRouteClasses.minimumEvidence: Confirmed negative-value missing code map and variable-specific skip-logic handling.

requiredRouteClasses.meaning: The record cannot be safely assigned to alive, death or missing route classes with current evidence.
requiredRouteClasses.minimumEvidence: Explicit not-classifiable denominator rule and review status.

requiredRouteClasses.meaning: The route detail requires sensitive or restricted NHATS files not approved for the first public-use pass.
requiredRouteClasses.minimumEvidence: File-tier table linking the route to sensitive or restricted resources and a pre-registered exclusion rule.

requiredRouteClasses.meaning: The aggregate route cell cannot be publicly exported because disclosure control flags cell size or sensitivity.
requiredRouteClasses.minimumEvidence: Disclosure-control validator result with n < 5 suppression or stricter restriction handling.

requiredRouteFields.minimumEvidence: Confirmed sample-person join key for R13/R14 linkage.
Confirmed baseline eligibility rule and denominator inclusion boundary.
Confirmed follow-up interview status field and value labels.
Confirmed proxy interview, proxy respondent or proxy measurement route field.
Confirmed facility, nursing-home, residential care or living-arrangement route field.
Confirmed death, decedent or mortality-boundary field without individual death-date exposure.
Confirmed variable-level missing, refusal, don't-know, inapplicable and skip-code map.
Confirmed linkage from route classes to analysis weight, strata, PSU/cluster and variance method.
Aggregate cell count and suppression flag required for every public route output cell.

candidateFieldFamilies.candidatePattern: spid or official sample-person identifier family
candidateFieldFamilies.sourceBoundary: Candidate role only; exact R13/R14 join key must be confirmed through Colectica/codebook before extraction.
Candidate role only; do not infer alive/death/nonresponse routes from prose labels.

candidateFieldFamilies.candidatePattern: round-specific proxy respondent / proxy route family
candidateFieldFamilies.sourceBoundary: Candidate role only; proxy route aggregation must be pre-registered.

candidateFieldFamilies.candidatePattern: round-specific residential care / facility / nursing-home route family
candidateFieldFamilies.role: candidate facility or residential route family
candidateFieldFamilies.sourceBoundary: Candidate role only; sensitive-file requirements and endpoint interpretation must be confirmed.
Candidate role only; no individual death-date, date-of-death or mortality rank may be exported.
Candidate convention only; every selected variable needs a field-level missing-code map from official documentation.

dominanceRules.rule: If confirmed death/decedent status is present, the record routes to decedent_or_death_boundary and must not be interpreted as an alive functional-status observation.
Missing, refusal, don't-know, inapplicable and nonresponse states must not be converted into alive, dead, impaired or healthy endpoint states.
Alive self, alive proxy and alive facility/residential routes must remain separate until an aggregation rule is pre-registered.
Not-classifiable rows cannot be silently dropped; the denominator rule must preserve or explicitly account for them.
Public route outputs must suppress n < 5 cells or apply stricter disclosure handling before export.

readinessGates.requiredEvidence: Exact route variables and value labels confirmed from NHATS Cross-Year Search / Colectica or official codebooks.
R13 denominator, eligibility and sample-person inclusion rule confirmed.
R14 interview status, final disposition or follow-up route field confirmed.
Death/decedent boundary field confirmed without individual death-date exposure.
Proxy and facility/residential route fields confirmed with aggregation boundary.
Field-level missing, refusal, don't-know, inapplicable and skip-code crosswalk complete.
Route classes can be linked to confirmed weight, strata, PSU/cluster and variance method.
Aggregate-only, n < 5 suppression, no row-level output and no public-AI upload validation complete.
Route classifier script reviewed against dominance rules, missingness handling, survey design, disclosure and no-individual-prediction gates.

prohibitedActions: Do not classify endpoint routes before exact route fields and value labels are confirmed.
Do not treat missingness, refusal, don't know, inapplicable, skip logic or nonresponse as alive, dead, impaired or healthy endpoint states.
Do not merge self, proxy, facility and known-alive-not-interviewed routes before an aggregation rule is pre-registered.
Do not compute weighted route counts before survey-design linkage is ready.
Do not export route counts before disclosure control passes.
Do not upload raw, row-level, derived disclosive or unpublished NHATS route outputs to public AI systems.
Do not output individual death dates, personal medical advice, personal longevity ranking or individual prediction.
nextWork: Confirm exact R13/R14 route variables and value labels through Colectica/codebooks.
Map field-level negative missing codes and skip logic before endpoint construction.
Bind the missingness-route validator to survey-design and disclosure-control validators.
Keep route validation synthetic-only until governed access, exact fields, reviewed classifier code and disclosure control exist.
